role: Villager door task: opens the wooden door on its path for 20 ticks, then (closeDoor true, which the villager passes) closes it again on reset.

members.name: field_75361_i
members.note: the villager passes true; the native registration has no flag but ai_reset always closes, which matches the only registrant

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: inherited from EntityAIDoorInteract, implemented as the AIC_OPEN_DOOR case: horizontal collision, a door within 1.5 blocks of the first two path points or above the entity

members.name: updateTask
members.note: --door_counter, then EntityAIDoorInteract.updateTask's dot product; EntityAIOpenDoor.startExecuting does not call super, so entityPositionX/Z stay 0.0F and the flag never sets

notes: EntityAIDoorInteract (the abstract parent, in this package) holds the door search and the entityPosX/Y/Z fields; its state lives in ai_task's door_x/y/z, door_pos_x/z and has_stopped_door_interaction. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-village-full-s42, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
